description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for the `git restore` command. It sets up a git repository with various states and performs restore operations to verify their correctness, including scenarios with staged changes, untracked files, unmerged states, and merge conflict resolutions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands that are expected to fail, to verify failure behavior.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or outputs for equality, used to verify test outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after a test completes, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a given output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_rev_parse
methods.description: Runs 'git rev-parse' and verifies the output or behavior.
